title: Engram project-reset release no longer runs the never-woken mailbox reconcile for affected sessions with an empty queue
outcome: A project-reset fence release still recovers mailbox wakes the store recorded but never queued, for every session the fence held, without preparing Engram context for sessions with nothing to start.
acceptance: Engram project-reset release no longer runs the never-woken mailbox reconcile for affected sessions with an empty queue is done
